_about: Megaloceros stag landmarks in the prepped Tripo mesh's own units (head to -Y, hooves at z=0, ~1 unit long). Leg joints below the belly come from cross-section centroids at these heights; the rest are placed by eye on the grid render (docs/orchestration/reports/sp-megaloceros/rig_landmarks_stag.png).
_size: ASSUMPTION: a big Irish elk stag stands ~2.1 m at the withers; x1.6 house exaggeration (claude-raptorscale.md) = 3.36 m.

antlers._about: MEGANTLERS: the Tripo image-to-model rack (task 48c4db1d-c6b8-40fb-a881-4cff854d7c78) cleaned by antler_prep.py. pitch_deg leans each side back about its burr, roll_deg [left, right] drops its outer end (the right palm hangs lower in the Tripo rack and brushed the neck ruff when grazing), both bent in along the beam between bend_raw (raw rack units from the burr) so the burr keeps its seat; the pair is scaled to span_m tip to tip. seat_m: the left burr centre (game metres, the right mirrored); pedicle_m: where its pedicle ends inside the skull (a hide-covered stalk from the burr down into the head), its ring shrunk by pedicle_shrink. fade_m: the burr base is baked toward the hide colour over this length above the cut.
